title: Build a low-rank update and a tiny fine-tune
brief: Match a LoRA forward and merge to a dense product, freeze the feature encoder, and beat a from-scratch CTC loss on seeded tones.
hints: forward is x @ weight.T + (alpha / A.shape[0]) * (x @ A.T) @ B.T. merge adds that scaled B @ A onto weight.
trainable_count is A.size + B.size. The frozen weight is not in the count.
freeze_feature_encoder is false when the name contains feature_encoder or feature_extractor. ctc_head_only is true only for ctc_head or lm_head.
Call torch.manual_seed(seed) immediately before each fresh TinyCTC. Cycle labels with labels % 3 + 1, then score the original labels. SGD learning rate 0.5, 60 pretrain steps, 10 adaptation steps.
